Barman is an [[NPCs|NPC]] created to run the [[Talking Skull]] Tavern. He is crafted from the [[Barman Doll]] which can be created at the [[Carpenter's workbench II]]. Once created and placed behind the tavern's bar, it becomes inhabited by the ghost named [[Yorick]], who you've hired (for no pay) to sell food and drinks for you.
